attribution: Tau minimal reproductions of the 2026-10-08 live kernel-skill acceptance runs (Codex over ACP in Tau desktop), where ordinary STEP chamfers, fillets and bolt patterns were refused, plus the negative controls that keep hole-absence verdicts honest.
runtimeDependency: All runtime inputs are files in this directory; the generators below are attribution only and are never run by the test.
bytePolicy: Byte-locked assets: do not reformat or regenerate. STEP headers carry the generation timestamp, so regeneration is not byte-identical.
